module_summary: launchelf.h is the umbrella header of the main EE program: version/debug macros, SDK includes, small string compat helpers, the SETTING config struct, and prototypes/externs for main, elf, draw, pad, config, filer, editor, lang, font and USB code. editor_private.h, filer_shared.h and filer_internal.h are the private interfaces of the text editor and file browser split across several .c files. ftp_protocol.h, nfsman.h, smb2man.h, smbd_devctl.h, pccf_control.h and wle_igr_config.h are fixed EE/IOP (or EE/IGR) wire ABIs shared with IRX or ELF sources; cloud_google.h is the Google Drive backup API; psu_types.h holds the memory-card/PSU header layouts. loader/loader.c plus loader/linkfile build the tiny embedded launcher ELF linked into 0x84000-0xa0000, which parses a '-la=' flag argument, optionally cleans DEV9/PFS and resets the IOP, then loads an ELF from a file or from memory. src/chkesr.c is the upstream ESR disc check.

reusable_helpers.name: wle_stricmp
reusable_helpers.what: ASCII case-insensitive string compare (stricmp macro alias); duplicates newlib strcasecmp

reusable_helpers.name: wle_strnlen
reusable_helpers.what: bounded strlen with NULL check (strnlen macro alias)

reusable_helpers.name: listCenteredTop
reusable_helpers.what: computes the first visible row so the selection stays in the upper middle of a scrolling list

reusable_helpers.name: parseHex8
reusable_helpers.what: parses exactly 8 hex digits into a u32

reusable_helpers.name: clearUserMem
reusable_helpers.what: zeroes EE user memory from 0x100000 with 128-bit stores

reusable_helpers.name: cleanupDev9ForLaunch
reusable_helpers.what: closes and unmounts pfs0-3, idles hdd0/hdd1 and optionally powers off DEV9 before handoff

reusable_helpers.name: loadELFImage
reusable_helpers.what: validates an in-memory MIPS ELF and copies/zeroes its PT_LOAD segments, returns the entry point

reusable_helpers.name: Check_ESR_Disc
reusable_helpers.what: reads DVD LBA 14 and checks for the ESR +NSR marker

findings.title: loadIcon is never called: TexIcon, src/icon.c (icon_folder/icon_warning) and FOLDER/WARNING are a dead chain
findings.problem: loadIcon has no caller (only its definition draw.c:206 and prototype launchelf.h:505); it is the only user of TexIcon, and TexIcon/icon_folder/icon_warning (2 x 1024-byte tables filling the 2055-line src/icon.c) are referenced nowhere else. The FOLDER and WARNING index macros are unused. loadIcon would also free() static arrays if it ever ran.
findings.fix: Delete loadIcon, TexIcon, the FOLDER/WARNING macros and the three externs and prototype in launchelf.h, delete src/icon.c and remove it from the wLaunchELF source list in ps2.yaml.
findings.benefit: ~2085 source lines removed (2055 of them a byte table). MEASURED: icon.o contributes 0 bytes to the linked ELF and .text.loadIcon (308 B) is already gc'd, but TexIcon keeps 80 B of .bss (xref OBJECT size 80); one fewer compile unit.
findings.evidence: git grep -nw over the whole repo for loadIcon, TexIcon, icon_folder, icon_warning, WARNING, FOLDER: loadIcon only draw.c:206 + launchelf.h:505; TexIcon only draw.c:15, draw.c:208-226, launchelf.h:473; icon_folder/icon_warning only icon.c:2/1030, draw.c:211/221, launchelf.h:469-470; WARNING only launchelf.h:467; FOLDER only launchelf.h:466 (plus a comment word in makeicon.c:375). evidence/Launchstation/raw/link/wLaunchELF-contrib-by-object.tsv:626 icon.o all zero; wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-first-party.tsv:53 .text.loadIcon 308; raw/xref/wLaunchELF-xref-candidates.tsv TexIcon OBJECT 80 .bss. No test references these names.

findings.title: UDPTTY, POWERPC_UART, IOPTRAP and COMMON_PRINTF debug variants cannot be built: their IRX blobs exist nowhere
findings.problem: No build file defines UDPTTY, POWERPC_UART, IOPTRAP or COMMON_PRINTF, and defining one cannot link: init.c imports udptty_irx/ppctty_irx/ioptrap_irx via IMPORT_BIN2C but no udptty, ppctty or ioptrap module is embedded or present anywhere in the repo. COMMON_PRINTF appears only in its own #elif. With both UDPTTY and POWERPC_UART, init.c:3080/3086 would also redeclare i, d.
findings.fix: Delete the UDPTTY, POWERPC_UART, IOPTRAP and COMMON_PRINTF branches (version suffix, DPRINTF #elif, IMPORT_BIN2C lines, module loads, build-info lines). Keep SIO_DEBUG, NO_IOP_RESET and ULE_DEBUG_BUILD, which need no missing blobs. Keep launchelf.h:36, which tests/test_project_branding.py checks.
findings.benefit: ~45 source lines and 4 dead build variants removed; no shipped-ELF change (code is preprocessed out) (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: git grep -n -i 'udptty|ppctty|ioptrap' over the whole repo (excluding docs): only the cited #if blocks in launchelf.h, init.c, main_info_screens.c, dash_info.c; nothing in ps2.yaml, scripts/configure_ds34.py, src/embed_blobs.S or iop/. grep of ps2.yaml for UDPTTY/POWERPC_UART/IOPTRAP/COMMON_PRINTF: none (brief section 2 lists the defines). COMMON_PRINTF: single mention launchelf.h:160. No test mentions these macros.

findings.title: LIBCDVD_LEGACY is never defined: include/snippets/readCD.h and the legacy CDVD branches are dead
findings.problem: No build defines LIBCDVD_LEGACY (ps2.yaml defines LIBCDVD_LATEST, which nothing tests). The legacy readCD() in snippets/readCD.h is only included from filer.c's #else branch, and the legacy cdvd_rpc.h include and CDVD_* macro set are likewise never selected.
findings.fix: Delete include/snippets/readCD.h (and the now empty snippets folder), the #ifndef/#else/#endif around readCD in filer.c, the LIBCDVD_LEGACY include branch in launchelf.h and the legacy half of cdvd_macro.h; drop the unused LIBCDVD_LATEST define from ps2.yaml.
findings.benefit: ~62 source lines and one file removed; no ELF change (preprocessed out) (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: git grep -n LIBCDVD_LEGACY: only include/cdvd_macro.h:4, launchelf.h:66, snippets/readCD.h:1-2, src/filer.c:604; not in ps2.yaml, scripts/configure_ds34.py or tests. git grep 'snippets': only src/filer.c:657. tests/test_listing_complete.py:253 checks the live fileXio readCD signature in filer.c, which stays.

findings.title: reopenPadPorts is never called in either pad variant; pad_reopen_active and its waitPadReady deadline branch are dead with it
findings.problem: reopenPadPorts is defined in pad.c and pad_ds34.c and declared in launchelf.h, but nothing calls it (USB-STABILITY-AUDIT-2026-10-08.md:37 already records the removal of its caller). pad_reopen_active is set only inside it, so the deadline/DelayThread branch of waitPadReady can never run.
findings.fix: Delete both reopenPadPorts definitions and the prototype, delete pad_reopen_active and the deadline branch in waitPadReady, and drop the matching cases in tests/test_device_input.py and the stub in tests/test_usb_storage_lifecycle.py.
findings.benefit: ~63 source lines removed. MEASURED: .text.reopenPadPorts (252 B) already gc'd (wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-first-party.tsv:69); waitPadReady loses a never-taken branch (a few bytes, INFERRED).
findings.evidence: git grep -nw reopenPadPorts: definitions pad.c:432, pad_ds34.c:490, prototype launchelf.h:527, a test stub tests/test_usb_storage_lifecycle.py:63 and the audit .md; no caller in src/, igr/, include/. git grep -nw pad_reopen_active: pad.c:15, 355, 360, 441, 443 and tests/test_device_input.py:410-429 only. xref: reopenPadPorts relocs_in_own_object 0.

findings.title: Unused functions and globals declared in these headers: filerPasteInto, getVirtualKeyboardEditorDisplayChar, CurrTime, mcfreeSpace, HFONTS
findings.problem: Each name appears only at its definition and its header declaration: filerPasteInto (callers use filerPasteModeInto), getVirtualKeyboardEditorDisplayChar, the u64 CurrTime, int mcfreeSpace (a test only asserts its old use is absent), and const int HFONTS (gui.c has its own local HFONTS enum).
findings.fix: Delete the two functions, the three variables and their header declarations (keep WFONTS in editor_input.c).
findings.benefit: ~20 lines removed. MEASURED: both functions already gc'd (40 B + 380 B); CurrTime 8 B and mcfreeSpace 4 B .bss and HFONTS 4 B .rodata stay linked because wLaunchELF has no -fdata-sections (xref sizes; BUILD-EVIDENCE.md:107).
findings.evidence: git grep -nw for each name over the whole repo: filerPasteInto only filer_browser.c:2315 + launchelf.h:589; getVirtualKeyboardEditorDisplayChar only virtual_keyboard.c:371 + launchelf.h:703; CurrTime only main.c:36 + launchelf.h:652; mcfreeSpace only filer.c:113 + filer_shared.h:54 + a negative assert string in tests/test_r3z_browser_wins.py:29; HFONTS: editor_input.c:7, editor_private.h:92, and gui.c:149 which is a separate local enum. raw/xref/wLaunchELF-xref-candidates.tsv: all five with relocs_in_own_object 0.

findings.title: Commented-out WriteFont_C and stale banners in draw.c and launchelf.h
findings.problem: WriteFont_C is a 54-line commented-out font dumper with a commented prototype and a commented call; draw.c:339-341 is a banner for transcpy_sjis, which now lives in dash_font.c. launchelf.h:38 is a commented SIO_DEBUG define, and launchelf.h:747 names a nonexistent chkesr_rpc.c (the file is src/chkesr.c).
findings.fix: Delete the commented WriteFont_C block, its commented prototype and call, the orphan transcpy_sjis banner and the commented SIO_DEBUG line; fix the chkesr comment or drop it.
findings.benefit: ~66 comment lines removed; no ELF change.
findings.evidence: Read draw.c:336-400: WriteFont_C inside /* */ (345-397). git grep -nw WriteFont_C: only commented lines draw.c:343-399, launchelf.h:507-508, main_info_screens.c:303. git grep -nw transcpy_sjis: defined in src/dash_font.c:135, not draw.c. git grep chkesr_rpc: only launchelf.h:747; ps2.yaml:573 builds src/chkesr.c.

findings.title: wle_stricmp and wle_strnlen reimplement newlib strcasecmp and strnlen
findings.problem: launchelf.h carries static inline copies of ASCII case-insensitive compare and strnlen, aliased by macro to stricmp/strnlen. The EE build already calls newlib's strcasecmp/strncasecmp directly (dash_card_tool.c:1715, cloud_http.c:509), so the library versions are linked and available; strnlen has only two callers.
findings.fix: Replace the helpers with '#define stricmp strcasecmp' (include strings.h) and use newlib strnlen; change ember.c:206 to strcasecmp.
findings.benefit: ~36 lines removed from the umbrella header included by every EE file; negligible ELF change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read launchelf.h:108-147. git grep -nw: strcasecmp in src/dash_card_tool.c:1715,2345,2437; strncasecmp in cloud_http.c:509, dash_main.c:403; wle_stricmp direct use only ember.c:206; strnlen callers main_gameid.c:34, main_startup.c:84. INFERRED: that newlib's string.h exposes strnlen under the build's default C mode (not compiled here).

findings.title: Unused cosdgf/sindgf/WLE_DEG_TO_RADF compatibility macros in launchelf.h
findings.problem: The floatlib compatibility macros cosdgf, sindgf and WLE_DEG_TO_RADF are referenced only by each other inside this block.
findings.evidence: git grep -nw cosdgf / sindgf / WLE_DEG_TO_RADF over the whole repo: only launchelf.h:96-105.

findings.title: smb2Connect_out_t is never written by smb2man; the EE passes a dummy out buffer
findings.problem: The header says ctx is 'not written: kept so the EE's call is unchanged'; smb2man_connect_devctl (iop/smb2man/smb2man.c:1491, called at 1552) takes only the input struct. The EE still declares, zeroes and passes the out struct, while the NFS connect beside it passes NULL, 0 (smb_shares.c:256).
findings.fix: Delete smb2Connect_out_t and pass NULL, 0 as the out buffer, as NFS_DEVCTL_CONNECT does; update tests/smb2man_live/drive.c:58 the same way.
findings.benefit: ~7 lines removed; one 4-byte devctl out buffer less per SMB2 connect (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: git grep -nw smb2Connect_out_t: smb2man.h:25, smb_shares.c:227, tests/smb2man_live/drive.c:58. Read smb_shares.c:224-240 and 256; grep of iop/smb2man/smb2man.c: devctl dispatch at 1552 passes only arg to smb2man_connect_devctl(const smb2Connect_in_t *in).

findings.title: Loader '-la=' flags N and D and DEV9_CLEANUP_HDD are never produced
findings.problem: The only producers of the loader flag string are src/elf.c:577 ('-la=E' or '-la=ER') and src/elf.c:823 ('-la=A' plus optional R and H). N (HDD-only cleanup) and D (explicit none) are never emitted, so cleanup is always either NONE or ALL and the three-value enum plus the DEV9_CLEANUP_ALL test only serve unused modes.
findings.fix: Delete the N and D cases and the DEV9_CLEANUP_HDD value; make the cleanup a plain flag set by H that always powers off DEV9 after the HDD idle.
findings.benefit: ~10 lines removed and a few dozen bytes from the loader ELF that must fit 0x84000-0xa0000 (INFERRED, not measured).
findings.evidence: git grep -n '-la=' over src/ and igr/: only elf.c:577 and elf.c:823; no test passes N or D (grep tests for '-la=' and DEV9_CLEANUP: none). tests/test_ember_iop_handoff.py only asserts 'reset_iop = 0;' and "case 'R':" in main(), which stay.

findings.title: PS2TIME in filer_shared.h duplicates ps2time in psu_types.h
findings.problem: Both headers declare the same 8-byte memory-card timestamp (u8 unused/sec/min/hour/day/month, u16 year) under two names; PS2TIME is used in filer_actions.c and filer_browser.c, ps2time in the PSU headers.
findings.fix: Keep one typedef (psu_types.h's ps2time), include psu_types.h from filer_shared.h and rename the PS2TIME uses, or make PS2TIME a one-line typedef of ps2time.
findings.evidence: Read both structs: identical member order and types (aligned(2) on PS2TIME matches the natural u16 alignment). git grep -nw PS2TIME: filer_shared.h:15, filer_actions.c:1283,1322, filer_browser.c:1067,1825,2032,2074,2091 (+tests). ps2time in iop/oldlibs/ps2ftpd is a separate IOP type and not affected.

findings.title: Symbols used only in their own file are exported through these headers
findings.problem: LaunchArgsCopyToArgv (elf.c), Menu_title_y (draw.c), joy_value (pad.c / pad_ds34.c), initConfig and saveConfigToPath (config.c), PathPad_menu (filer_browser.c), getEditorSpecialKeyboardNextKey (editor_input.c), readSMB, host_ready and host_use_Bsl (filer.c) are referenced only inside the file that defines them, yet are declared extern in shared headers.
findings.fix: Drop the header declarations and make the definitions static (adding a forward declaration only where the use precedes the definition).
findings.benefit: ~10 header lines removed; static lets the compiler inline or drop them. Size effect not measured (INFERRED small).
findings.evidence: raw/xref/wLaunchELF-xref-candidates.tsv lists each as defined and not referenced by any other object of the link. git grep -nw for each name over the whole repo confirms uses only in the defining .c (DS34 pad_ds34.c keeps its own joy_value); tests only copy or text-match them (tests/test_smb_shares.py:220 matches 'int readSMB(', which a static definition still contains).

findings.title: Duplicate extern declarations of LastDir, elisaFnt and latestDVRPMount
findings.problem: filer_shared.h includes launchelf.h and then redeclares LastDir and elisaFnt, and filer_internal.h redeclares latestDVRPMount, all already declared in launchelf.h.
findings.fix: Delete the three redundant declarations in filer_shared.h and filer_internal.h.
findings.evidence: Read filer_shared.h:4 (#include launchelf.h), filer_internal.h:4 (#include filer_shared.h). git grep -nw: LastDir extern at launchelf.h:349 and filer_shared.h:92; elisaFnt at launchelf.h:576 and filer_shared.h:51; latestDVRPMount at launchelf.h:571 and filer_internal.h:8, both under #ifdef DVRP.
